name: Whisparr Sync
summary: Keeps Cove in step with the Whisparr instance you configure, calling out to it with an API key you supply and Cove holds server-side. Connect to either Whisparr generation, test the connection, and register Cove's import callback in the instance. One endpoint answers anonymously - the import callback Whisparr posts to - and it is authenticated by a secret this extension mints rather than by a Cove permission; every other endpoint requires one. The import path itself is still being built, so a delivery is checked and acknowledged rather than acted on.
